functional_requirements: Through-hole is a clearance/threaded fastening feature on the upright leg: Ø8 mm through a 5 mm wall for M8 fastening (note: standard M8 clearance is 8.4 mm, so Ø8.0 gives a snug fit).
Load path: load is transferred from the fastened upright leg through the 90 degree bend into the horizontal base leg; the bend region is the primary stress concentration.
Mounting: the upright leg's outer face (X = 0 plane) mounts flat against a vertical face/surface; the base leg's bottom face (Z = 0) rests on a horizontal surface.
Hole edge margin: Ø8 hole leaves 6 mm of material to the top edge and 6 mm to the lateral edge on the smaller face.
Manufacturing intent: single-piece bracket; 3D printed (FDM) assumed by default unless CNC metal is specified.
special_features: The part MUST be a 90 degree L-profile extruded through OVERALL_DEPTH_Y: horizontal base leg spanning X = 0..OVERALL_WIDTH_X at Z = 0..WALL_THICKNESS, plus vertical upright leg spanning X = UPRIGHT_OUTER_FACE_X..UPRIGHT_THICKNESS_X at Z = 0..OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z, fused into one solid at the bend.
Both legs MUST use the single uniform wall thickness WALL_THICKNESS = 5 mm; no tapering or varying wall sections.
The through-hole MUST be placed on the SMALLER face, defined as the upright leg's outer face at X = UPRIGHT_OUTER_FACE_X (50 mm in Y x 40 mm in Z), NOT on the larger base-leg top face.
The through-hole MUST penetrate along the X axis (normal to the upright outer face), passing through the 5 mm upright wall; it MUST NOT be oriented along the Z or Y axis.

The through-hole centre MUST lie 10 mm (HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET) from the top edge of the smaller face (Z = OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z - 10 = HOLE_CENTER_Z = 30) and 10 mm from the adjacent lateral edge (Y = HOLE_CENTER_Y = 10), i.e. a (10, 10) corner offset on that face.
The through-hole MUST be a true through-hole with a fully open cylindrical bore on both the X = 0 and X = 5 faces; it MUST NOT be a blind or partial-depth pocket.
The through-hole MUST NOT intersect the base leg, the bend region, or any outer edge of the part (6 mm minimum remaining edge margin all around).

The upright leg MUST be located at the X-min end of the bracket so the base leg projects in the +X direction away from the bend; the two outer faces (X = 0 and Z = 0) MUST meet at the corner_min origin (0, 0, 0).

sketches.notes: Horizontal base-leg footprint on the XY plane, corner_min origin convention: sketch-local x = world X (0..50 = OVERALL_WIDTH_X), sketch-local y = world Y (0..50 = OVERALL_DEPTH_Y). Closed 4-vertex profile (0,0)-(50,0)-(50,50)-(0,50); extruded +Z by WALL_THICKNESS = 5 mm to give the base leg Z = 0..5.

Vertical upright-leg profile on the YZ plane placed at the X-min end (workplane_offset_mm = 0.0 -> world X = 0 = UPRIGHT_OUTER_FACE_X). On this plane sketch-local x = world Y and sketch-local y = world Z (Iron Rule 1: world Z maps to local y). Closed 4-vertex profile (0,0)-(50,0)-(50,40)-(0,40) gives the protruding rectangular wall Y = 0..50 (OVERALL_DEPTH_Y) and Z = 0..40 (OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z), overlapping the base leg for the fuse. Extruded +X by UPRIGHT_THICKNESS_X = 5 mm to give X = 0..5.

steps.label: Extrude horizontal base leg 50 x 50 x 5 (Z = 0 to 5)
steps.notes: Base leg = X 0..50, Y 0..50, Z 0..5 (WALL_THICKNESS = 5 mm uniform). Its bottom face Z = 0 is the mounting face; the +X end (X = 50) is the free end away from the bend. Volume = 50 * 50 * 5 = 12500 mm^3.

steps.label: Extrude vertical upright leg 50 x 40 x 5 (X = 0 to 5)
steps.notes: Upright leg = X 0..5 (UPRIGHT_THICKNESS_X = WALL_THICKNESS = 5 mm, no taper), Y 0..50, Z 0..40. Outer face X = 0 (the SMALLER 50 x 40 face that carries the hole) and bottom face Z = 0 meet at the corner_min origin (0,0,0) as required. The leg spans Z = 0..40, so it overlaps the base leg in the region X 0..5, Y 0..50, Z 0..5 -> they form one 90 degree L-profile extruded through OVERALL_DEPTH_Y = 50 mm. Volume = 5 * 50 * 40 = 10000 mm^3.

steps.label: Fuse base leg and upright leg into one solid L-bracket
steps.notes: Single connected solid, exactly ONE body. Fused volume before the hole = 12500 + 10000 - 1250 (shared bend region 5 x 50 x 5) = 21250 mm^3; after the Ø8 through-hole (pi * 4^2 * 5 = 251.3 mm^3) = 20998.7 mm^3, matching target_volume_mm3.

steps.label: Drill Ø8 through-hole along X through the 5 mm upright wall
steps.notes: Through-hole along the X axis (normal to the upright outer face X = 0; NOT along Z or Y), drilling the full UPRIGHT_THICKNESS_X = 5 mm wall X = 0..5 and breaking out as an open cylindrical bore on BOTH the X = 0 and X = 5 faces (no blind pocket). Radius 4 mm leaves (10 - 4) = 6 mm of material to the Y = 0 lateral edge and to the Z = 40 top edge, and the bore (Z = 26..34) stays clear of the base leg (Z 0..5) and the bend region. Cutter cylinder should be generated with ~1 mm overshoot on both sides of the wall (X = -1 to X = 6).
